Job Summary**

Responsible for the safe and efficient transportation of live chicks within the company's operational areas, ensuring their well-being and timely delivery.

Job Responsibilities**

* Operate and maintain specialized chick vans in a safe and responsible manner, adhering to all traffic laws and company policies.
* Conduct pre-trip and post-trip inspections of the vehicle, reporting any defects or issues promptly.
* Ensure proper loading and unloading of chick crates, minimizing stress and injury to the chicks.
* Monitor environmental conditions within the van (temperature, ventilation) to ensure optimal conditions for chick transport.
* Maintain accurate records of mileage, fuel consumption, and delivery details.
* Communicate effectively with dispatch, farm staff, and other relevant personnel.
* Adhere to strict biosecurity protocols to prevent the spread of diseases.
* Perform routine cleaning and sanitization of the vehicle.
* Respond to emergencies or unexpected situations during transportation.

Job Qualifications**

* Valid Heavy Commercial (HC) or Pink Light Commercial (PNKLN LADA) driver's license with a clean driving record.
* Minimum 2 years of experience in commercial driving, preferably with livestock or fragile goods.
* Knowledge of vehicle maintenance and basic troubleshooting.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Strong commitment to animal welfare and safety.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Physically fit and able to lift and move heavy objects (chick crates).
* Willingness to work flexible hours, including early mornings, evenings, and weekends as required.
* Understanding of biosecurity principles is a plus.




JAPFA is an agribusiness company that engages mainly in the production of animal feed, poultry breeding, commercial farm, consumer products, aquaculture, and beef cattle farming. Founded in Indonesia and now headquartered in Singapore, we employ over 37,000 people across an integrated network of modern farming, processing and distribution facilities in Indonesia, Vietnam, India, Myanmar, and Bangladesh. We believe our people are the key to staying ahead, and we continuously seek talented individuals to grow with us and contribute to our mission.

PT JAPFA FOOD INDONESIA (WONOAYU)

Job Responsibilities
* Perform thorough cleaning and sanitization of production machinery, equipment, facilities, and work areas in accordance with Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
* Handle, mix, and apply sanitation chemicals and cleaning agents safely and in correct dilutions.
* Conduct pre-operative inspections to ensure all equipment is free of contaminants before production runs begin.
* Adhere strictly to company safety guidelines, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points (HACCP), and occupational health and safety regulations.
* Document and maintain accurate records of sanitation activities, chemical usage, and inspection checklists.
* Report any equipment malfunctions, safety hazards, or pest control issues to the supervisor immediately.
* Assist in waste management and disposal processes in compliance with environmental and company policies.

Job Qualifications
* Proven experience as a Sanitation Operator, Cleaner, or in a similar role within the food processing, animal feed, or manufacturing industry is highly advantageous.
* Basic understanding of food safety standards, GMP, and the safe handling of industrial cleaning chemicals.
* Physical stamina and ability to perform manual labor, including lifting heavy loads, bending, and standing for extended periods in various temperature environments.
* Strong attention to detail, discipline, and a high level of commitment to hygiene and safety protocols.
* Ability to work effectively in a team and adaptability to work in shifts, including night shifts and weekends when required.
